name: CMYK Gamut Warning
description: Flags RGB/hex colors that are likely out of typical CMYK print gamut, using a heuristic saturation/brightness check — approximate, not a substitute for a real color-managed proof.

tools.name: check_cmyk_gamut
tools.description: Heuristically flags hex colors that are likely to print poorly (very vivid/neon colors outside typical CMYK gamut).
